description: This file defines the HandlerStack class in the GuzzleHttp namespace, responsible for creating, managing, and resolving a stack of middleware handlers for HTTP requests, including methods for adding, removing, and debugging middleware.

classes.name: HandlerStack
classes.description: Class for creating and managing a stack of middleware handlers for HTTP requests, supporting middleware addition, removal, and resolution.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Creates a default handler stack with common middleware for errors, redirects, cookies, and body preparation.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the handler stack with an optional underlying handler.

methods.name: __invoke
methods.description: Invokes the handler stack as a composed handler with a request and options.

methods.name: __toString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the handler stack for debugging.

methods.name: setHandler
methods.description: Sets the underlying HTTP handler that returns a promise.

methods.name: hasHandler
methods.description: Checks if the handler stack has an underlying handler set.

methods.name: unshift
methods.description: Adds middleware to the bottom of the stack.

methods.name: push
methods.description: Adds middleware to the top of the stack.

methods.name: before
methods.description: Inserts middleware before another middleware by name.

methods.name: after
methods.description: Inserts middleware after another middleware by name.

methods.name: remove
methods.description: Removes middleware from the stack by instance or name.

methods.name: resolve
methods.description: Resolves and composes the middleware stack into a single callable handler.

methods.name: findByName
methods.description: Finds the index of a middleware in the stack by name.

methods.name: splice
methods.description: Inserts middleware into the stack at a specific position relative to another middleware.

methods.name: debugCallable
methods.description: Generates a string description for a callable for debugging purposes.
